visual_options.name: Artifact-First Paper Surfaces
visual_options.risk: Clever but visually off-brand and likely to generate stationery instead of relationship scenes.

visual_options.name: Literal Obedient Husband Comedy
visual_options.risk: Cheap India husband-wife joke; unsafe for brand taste.

visual_options.name: Soft Storybook Phrase-World Scenes
visual_options.risk: Must keep Zuv active and Aachu lovable, not generic.

selector_verdict: The repaired visual system wins because Indian on-ground connection comes from everyday Hinglish couple behavior: she redirects the world, he adjusts the world without making her feel difficult.

final_visual_plan.copy:
Me with my
"jo tu kahegi wahi hoga"
final_visual_plan.visual: Warm full-scene @a.storyof.two illustration. Aachu is mid-decision in an ordinary Indian public-life moment, laughing with shy dramatic energy and one hand near her face. Zuv stands close beside her with dark wavy hair, beard, thick brows, and an amused calm smile, already adjusting the plan on his phone with willing theek-hai energy. Their body language is the whole visual proof.

final_visual_plan.copy:
In another universe,
he still changes the plan.
final_visual_plan.visual: Soft storybook scene on an Indian street or inside a parked car: Aachu points toward a sudden new plan with sparkling certainty while Zuv calmly changes the route on his phone, already smiling. Tiny route arrows and checkmarks can float as hand-drawn scene doodles, but the main image remains their faces, hands, and shared joke.

Full illustrated everyday scene: they are almost about to argue, Aachu mock-annoyed and expressive, while Zuv steps in with water, keys, charger, or a small snack and a calm smile that softens the timing. A tiny handwritten status note may sit near them, integrated into the scene. No app UI, no calendar screen.

final_visual_plan.copy:
Terms & conditions:
she is probably right.
final_visual_plan.visual: Scene-first illustration: Aachu explains her logic with mock-serious confidence while Zuv looks at the phone, weather, menu, or route proof and realizes she was right. He adds his own amused checkmark gesture, smiling like he is in on the bit. The joke is mutual and affectionate, never a boss-wife setup.

final_visual_plan.copy:
Not because he lost.
Because he likes her world.
final_visual_plan.visual: Tender full-scene visual: Zuv voluntarily steps into Aachu’s lively little world of plans, moods, route arrows, tiny hearts, and playful notes. Aachu is inviting him in, not commanding him. His body leans forward with a warm smile so the viewer reads choice, delight, and participation.

final_visual_plan.copy:
Some men bring flowers.
Mine brings theek hai.
final_visual_plan.visual: Ordinary Indian couple moment in the accepted storybook style: Zuv offers theek-hai through action, maybe holding her bag, phone, water, keys, or changed plan with an amused soft smile. Aachu beams because the phrase has become his private love language. No literal bouquet, no grand romance pose, no label-only composition.
